title: A note on iterating strongly $(<λ)$-closed stationary $λ^+$-cc forcing
summary: We give an exposition of an iteration theorem for iterating $(<λ)$-closed stationary $λ^+$-cc forcing with supports of size $<λ$ and preserving these two properties. We discuss the relation of this theorem with other iteration theorems and forcing axioms that have appeared in the literature, notably the one from \cite{Sh80}.
